result.stderr:
WebEngine MCP server - observe and interact with web/mobile apps for AI coding agents.

Usage:
  webengine-mcp [--profile web|mobile|both] [--transport http|stdio]

Options:
  --profile web|mobile|both   Tool set to expose (default: both, respects appsettings IsEnabled flags).
                             web    = Selenium browser tools only  -> plugin 'webengine-web'.
                             mobile = Appium device tools only     -> plugin 'webengine-mobile'.
  --transport http|stdio      Transport to use (default: http for backward compatibility).
                             stdio is required for Copilot/Codex/Claude local plugins.
  -h, --help                Show this help.

Examples:
  webengine-mcp --profile web --transport stdio
  webengine-mcp --profile mobile --transport stdio
  dotnet run --project AxaFrance.WebEngine.Mcp -- --profile web --transport stdio
